details.report:
Committed c60449b. Added deterministic axis-specific method/output adapters to exact child prompt identities: Standards receives only the canonical Standards question and baseline burden; Spec receives only the canonical Spec question. The adapter explicitly preserves the unchanged canonical Skill/common bundle as semantic input, supersedes dual-agent/aggregation/dual-section mechanics, permits all common-material access and citation, and fixes one verbatim report as the complete output envelope without parsing, sanitizing, splitting, rewriting, aggregation, or replacement legs. Aligned the semantic auditor to package-owned output mechanics and canonical substantive semantics, including revision for cross-question assessment while making cross-material citation lawful. No Soul or canonical Skill edit/fork was made.

Tests cover deterministic axis-distinct identities, byte-identical common bundles and exact Skill bytes, fixed single-axis contracts, auditor pass/revision law, lawful cross-material use, and no parser/allowlist mechanics. Existing exact UTF-8 report preservation and runtime accepted-leg/receipt suites remain green.

Verification: focused Reviewer/receipt/native-session tests passed (44/44); typecheck passed; final isolated-HOME full suite passed (321 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed); tracked package artifacts regenerated; installed-package lifecycle passed; npm pack dry-run passed; cold-install dist import passed; git diff --check passed. The first full-suite run exposed one stale package-lifecycle assertion for the superseded one-line prompt; it was updated to assert both axis adapters, then the focused package test and final complete suite passed.
